adrenal-defense-full-help: Adrenal Defense: a full dodge can be declared (as concentration, unless instantaneous)
adrenal-defense-no-dodge: Adrenal Defense failed: no dodge this round
adrenal-defense-partial-help: Adrenal Defense: a partial dodge needs no concentration
aim-help: Aim a ranged weapon of your Sharpshooter at a foe for the whole round; the next shot against it with that weapon gets the bonus.
alert-critical-fumble: The fumble of {{attack}} gives a critical of severity {{severity}}.
alert-critical-fumble-help: Roll it by hand, of the type the fumble text says, and apply its result. Applying the alert marks it as resolved.
alert-death-threshold-help: From -300 total penalties the actor dies. It is never applied by itself: confirm it or dismiss it.
alert-death-threshold-text: The total penalties reach {{total}}: the actor dies unless the game master decides otherwise.
alert-endurance-penalty-dying: Total penalties of {{total}}: the actor is dying and rolls endurance every round.
alert-endurance-penalty-exertion: Total penalties of {{total}}: an action with effort asks for an endurance roll.
alert-fall-suggested-text: The {{skill}} {{origin}} ended in an absolute failure: the actor may fall. Resolve the fall, or dismiss it.
alert-knocked-back-hazard-intro: Knocked back {{feet}} feet: critical up to {{severity}}
alert-knocked-back-help: If the actor hits an obstacle or falls, resolve it as a hazard: its critical is never more severe than the one that knocked it back.
alert-knocked-back-recovery: The game master may ask for an Acrobatics or Running maneuver to keep standing.
alert-knocked-back-text: A critical knocks the actor back {{feet}} feet.
alert-limb-loss-help: The limb can no longer be used.
alert-limb-loss-text: The tourniquet on {{injury}} was tight for {{rounds}} rounds: the limb is lost
alert-mental-focus-help: Roll it by hand and mark the result: a failure breaks every concentration of the actor.
alert-mental-focus-text-double: Concentrating on two things at once: a Mental Focus maneuver keeps both.
alert-mental-focus-text-extended: Concentrating for {{rounds}} rounds: a Mental Focus maneuver keeps the concentration.
alert-mental-focus-text-stunned: Stunned while concentrating: a Mental Focus maneuver keeps the concentration.
alert-reaction-available-help: An immediate attack with a weapon of the talent: 0 AP, no AP penalty, its OB not reduced by parries. It expires when the phase ends.
alert-reaction-available-text-opportunis: {{target}} fumbled a melee attack against you: you can strike at once.
alert-reaction-available-text-riposte: After parrying {{target}} with all your OB and no damage, you can riposte at once.
alert-reaction-expired: The phase has ended: the reaction is no longer available.
alert-stray-shot-help: Confirm it to resolve a second attack with the same weapon against that combatant: no AP, OB 0, no cover, and fumbles are ignored. Or dismiss it.
alert-stray-shot-text: The {{weapon}} shot missed its target and may hit {{target}}.
alert-terrible-luck-help: The worst failure possible: narrate it and apply it by hand.
alert-tourniquet-loosen-help: A tourniquet kept tight too long costs the limb. Loosening it lets the wound bleed again.
alert-tourniquet-loosen-text: The tourniquet on {{injury}} has been tight for {{rounds}} rounds
alert-wound-reopened-help: The treatment of the wound is lost; it can be treated again.
alert-wound-reopened-text: The wound {{injury}} reopened ({{reason}}): it bleeds {{bleeding}} hits per round again
already-moving: A movement already covers this phase
attack-change-help: A parry lowered the OB of this attack. If you prepare it again, its defenders declare their parries again and the rolls already made are lost.
attack-location-roll-help: The target wears armor by location: roll the critical (1-100) with the attack. Its location decides the AT, and the criticals of the attack use it.
attack-mode-disarm-help: The attack tries to knock the foe's weapon away: the defender's roll is entered, and the result follows the bands of the table. A partial result goes on as a normal attack.
attack-mode-subdual-help: The attack tries to knock the foe out: half the hits, and the critical is a subdual one, never above E.
attack-next-step-pending_critical_roll: The attack causes a critical: enter the critical roll.
attack-no-ob-left: No OB left this round: it cannot attack with this.
battle-cry-foe-level: Level of the highest level foe
bmr-effective: Base movement rate with what halves it
breakage-temporary: Temporary damage: it does not last after the game
breath-check-help: Roll it by hand and mark the result: a failure starts the suffocation (1d10 hits per round; underwater it inhales water, stunned -50).
breath-constitution-bonus-npc: Give it for an NPC (0 when left empty)
breath-constitution-bonus-sheet: Empty: the one of the character sheet
breath-help: Prepared, the limit is 12 rounds plus the Constitution bonus; caught unawares, the bonus alone (at least 1). Past the limit, a check every round, each one harder.
breath-holding-help: Breath Holding: the limit grows with the level, more while inactive or meditating.
breath-suffocating-help: Suffocating: it takes 1d10 hits each round until it breathes again.
called-shot-clear-hint: Click the part again to clear the called shot.
called-shot-hint: Click a part of the body to aim at it.
cauterize-heat-critical: Cauterizing inflicts a {{severity}} Heat critical: resolve it on the patient.
cauterize-heat-critical-alert: The heat critical is waiting as an alert of the patient.
cauterize-heat-help: Optional: the dice of the extra hits and of the heat critical. Left empty, the server rolls the hits and leaves the critical as an alert.
cauterize-unusual-event: Unmodified 66: the patient catches fire. The game master decides what happens.
complementary-skill-help: Each helper adds the ranks of a skill that helps: the first all of them, each next one half of the one before.
concentration-double-warning: Concentrating on two things: the actor only moves at creeping pace, and a Mental Focus maneuver keeps both.
concentration-help: While concentrating, each AP of another action counts half; a movement goes at half the BMR.
continues-next-round: It will go on in the next round.
continues-previous-round_one: Continues an action of the previous round (+{{count}} AP)
continues-previous-round_other: Continues an action of the previous round (+{{count}} AP)
critical-alert-help: The critical is applied to the actor (hits, injuries and effects) and the alert closes.
critical-alert-origin-environment: the extreme temperature of the environment
critical-alert-origin-hazard: a fall, a falling object or an extreme temperature
critical-alert-origin-other: a maneuver or the heat of a cauterization
critical-alert-result-shift_one: Use the result {{count}} row lower than the one of the roll.
critical-alert-result-shift_other: Use the result {{count}} rows lower than the one of the roll.
critical-alert-type-help: The code the fumble text names: S, K, P...
critical-below-a-none: The {{severity}} critical drops below A: it is removed and not rolled.
critical-roll-from-location: The location roll ({{roll}}) is the critical roll of this attack.
critical-roll-shared_one: One roll for the {{count}} critical of the attack
critical-roll-shared_other: One roll for the {{count}} criticals of the attack
damage-composition: {{hit}} from the hit + {{criticals}} from the criticals
dash-other-actions: The actor has spent AP on other actions this round
dash-previous-phase: It needs half its BMR moved in the previous phase
declare-warning-interrupts-treatment: Interrupts the treatment {{action}}: it is lost
declare-warning-unreachable: Will not reach its minimum of {{min}} AP this round.
defense-mode-help: Passive and partial are declared here. A full dodge or block is a 4 AP dodge action. A dodge and a block of the same kind do not add up.
defense-mode-no-shield: Without a shield the actor cannot block.
delete-action-closed-help: The action is already done: deleting it does not undo its effects.
delete-action-confirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this action?
delete-injury-confirmation: Delete this injury? Its penalty and bleeding stop counting.
disarm-defense-roll-help: Total of the defender's roll (its OB less any parry, plus the roll). Required.
disarm-defense-roll-modifier: Modifier to the disarm: {{value}} (100 less the defender's total)
disarm-result-absolute-failure-help: The attacker fumbles: roll the fumble.
disarm-result-absolute-success-help: The foe is disarmed and its weapon checked for breakage. The game master decides any further benefit of the absolute success.
disarm-result-failure-help: The foe keeps its weapon. No damage.
disarm-result-partial-help: The foe keeps its weapon, and the attack is resolved as a normal one.
disarm-result-success-help: The foe is disarmed when the attack is applied, and its weapon is checked for breakage.
disarm-unusual-help: Unmodified 66: something unusual happens, at the game master's choice.
draw-and-load-help: Choose the weapon drawn or loaded: with Quickdraw for it, it takes no AP.
endurance-encumbrance-auto: The load and armor maneuver penalties of the character sheet are added by themselves.
endurance-hours-half-water: Every 8 hours after a day of half water ({{modifier}})
endurance-hours-no-water: Hours after a day without water ({{modifier}})
environment-actor-help: Held breath with its limit and checks, and protection from the extreme temperature of the game.
expires-at-round-end: It will expire at the end of the round.
extreme-temperature-help: While it is set, each round raises its critical on every actor not protected from it.
faction-npc-actors-empty: No other NPCs of this faction in the game.
faction-without-characters: No character of this faction can take part
fatigue-critical-help: Fatigue of the criticals: outside the -50 cap, it goes after 12 rounds of rest.
fatigue-penalty-help: Fatigue penalty of the actor (up to -50): it recovers 1 point per 12 rounds of rest (24 at altitude).
fatigue-rest-rounds-help: Rounds in a row without exertion (walking counts as rest): every {{rounds}} recover one point, and clear the accumulator.
feat-of-strength-adrenal: Adrenal Strength multiplies the body weight by {{multiplier}}.
feat-of-strength-beyond-table: Beyond the table: Nigh Impossible, and the game master may rule it out.
feat-of-strength-explanation: {{load}} lb against {{body}} lb is {{percent}} %, less 2 × St ({{st}}): {{adjusted}} % → {{difficulty}}.
feat-of-strength-invalid-body-weight: Enter the body weight of the actor.
feat-of-strength-invalid-load: Enter the weight of the load.
feat-of-strength-invalid-mechanical-fact: The mechanical factor goes from 0.01 to 1.
feat-of-strength-invalid-skill: A feat of strength rolls Weight Training.
fighting-style-help: Kept in the next rounds until changed.
finish-at-risk-help: These characters still bleed or are dying: they are considered dead unless they are healed before finishing. Choose the fate of each one.
finish-no-characters: There are no characters in this game (NPCs are left out).
finish-tactical-game-help: Finishing closes the game: it becomes read-only and its outcome can then be applied to the strategic characters. The last round's upkeep is not run.
force-reason-effect-help: Granted by a critical, fumble or spell: no AP and no AP penalty.
force-reason-gm-help: Game master's decision: with the AP already spent and their penalty.
force-reason-pass-through-help: A foe passes through: spends the actor's next free AP, with the penalty of the total AP.
force-reason-stray-shot-help: Second attack of a shot into a melee that missed: no AP.
force-reason-withdrawal-help: A foe withdraws: spends the actor's next free AP, with the penalty of the total AP.
force-resolution-help: Resolve the action out of turn, without waiting for its minimum action points.
free-movement-attack-pace: This actor made a free movement at {{pace}} during this attack: its pace penalty applies, unless you mark a faster pace here.
free-movement-max-run: A free movement goes up to run
free-movement-palette-help: No AP, up to run; penalizes the actions done meanwhile
free-movement-unresolved-notice: This actor has a free movement still to resolve during this action: its pace penalty will not count until it is resolved.
frenzy-attack-nearest: In frenzy: attacks the nearest creature
frenzy-dying-survives: The actor holds on until the next upkeep.
gm-adjustment-help: Applies the result directly, without a medical action or its AP. In combat, declare a Medical action instead.
grapple-escape-help: A Feat of Strength contested with each grappler (Wrestling or Contortions), with the whole grapple penalty. The result takes its percent off the grapple. 2 to 4 AP.
grapple-feat: Feat of Strength to move away
grapple-feat-help: A grappled actor or its grappler needs a contested Feat of Strength to move away; failed, it does not move.
hazard-critical-alerts: The criticals without a roll are pending as alerts of the actor.
hazard-critical-pending: Pending: roll it in the alert
hazard-critical-rolls-help: Critical rolls, optional: the criticals without a roll stay as alerts of the actor.
hazard-db-help: The DB of the actor when empty
hazard-fall-control-help: Acrobatics: a success lowers the critical one level, an absolute success two, an absolute failure raises it one
hazard-fall-help: Crush attack of the size of the actor. OB: the feet fallen, less its height when it jumped on purpose. Only magical DB counts. A resolved fall-control maneuver moves the critical.
hazard-falling-object-help: Rock attack when the object is smaller than the actor, else Crush, with the size of the object (or its weight). OB: the feet it fell. The DB of the actor counts, and its shield on the Rock table.
hazard-no-fall-control: The actor has no resolved fall-control maneuver this round
hazard-severity-cap-help: A knock-back: the critical is no more severe than the one that knocked the actor back.
hazard-severity-unchanged: No size or fall control moved the critical.
hazard-temperature-help: Cold at {{cold}} °C or below, heat from {{heat}} °C: no attack roll, only the critical of cold, heat or steam. Give the temperature or, for a contact with frost or fire, the severity.
hazard-temperature-source-given: Severity given by the game master.
hazards-help: The game master resolves a fall of the actor (Crush table, OB the feet fallen, only magical DB) or an object falling on it (Rock when smaller than the actor, else Crush). The damage takes the Hit Multiplier of the size and the critical may move with the sizes and a fall control.
herb-use-combat-done: Herb used: {{hits}} hits healed, {{rounds}} stun rounds removed
herb-use-no-combat-items: The character carries no herb that heals hits or removes stun.
hold-action-help: Keep the action ready to resolve it later
hp-log-empty: No hit point changes in this round
initiative-lower-help: Acts later for the rest of the round (§8.3). It can go down to {{lowest}}. It cannot go back up, and the next round rolls again.
initiative-order-warning: {{actor}} (initiative {{initiative}}) has an action to resolve and goes first. You can go on: the game master decides.
initiative-tie-help: Tied on initiative with another actor: they act at the same time and neither changes what the others do (§8.3). The app resolves attacks one by one, so the game master decides how to apply it.
leader-fear-help: Optional: a recognized leader adds its Leadership ranks to the fear RR of the others.
leader-roll-help: Required: the leader makes the roll and is not one of the followers.
leader-summary: Leader: {{ranks}} Leadership ranks, {{bonus}} to the fear RR of the followers
light-source-calculator-help: The light of a source within 10', one level darker up to 30', two up to 100', three up to 300'; the brighter of it and the ambient light.
light-source-out-of-range: Out of range, no ambient light
limb-loss-confirm-help: Confirming it: {{limb}}. The limb is gone for good and its bleeding and tourniquet end.
limb-loss-origin-critical: The critical that caused {{injury}} may cost the limb.
limb-loss-origin-tourniquet: The tourniquet on {{injury}} was tight for {{rounds}} rounds: the limb may be lost.
log-empty: Nothing in round {{round}} with these filters
maneuver-fog-help: {{fog}}: visibility {{feet}}', {{vision}} to visual Perception and Tracking (vision talents do not reduce it); {{hearing}} to hear something beyond the visual range.
maneuver-purpose-help-adrenal-defense: Absolute maneuver on the adrenal table. From the next round: a partial dodge without concentration, or a full dodge kept as concentration; an absolute success allows an instantaneous full dodge in its first round.
maneuver-purpose-help-adrenal-focus: Absolute maneuver on the adrenal table. From the next round, a bonus to the Body Discipline, Brawn, Gymnastic and Movement maneuvers.
maneuver-purpose-help-adrenal-speed: Absolute maneuver on the adrenal table. From the next round, extra action points.
maneuver-purpose-help-adrenal-strength: Absolute maneuver on the adrenal table. From the next round, melee attacks count as one size larger and feats of strength multiply the body weight.
maneuver-purpose-help-feat-of-strength: Lift, push or drag a load: its weight against the body weight, less twice the St bonus, gives the difficulty.
maneuver-purpose-help-fortitude: Instantaneous (0 AP) absolute maneuver on the adrenal table: it halves the penalties at once (all of them in the first round of an absolute success).
maneuver-target-awareness: The target resists with its Social Awareness.
maneuver-target-help: Target actor: its roll and skill bonus give the passive total.
maneuver-target-trading: The target bargains with its own Trading.
medical-complete-help: All the rounds are done: resolving applies the treatment.
medical-dying-removed: The patient is no longer dying
medical-herbalism-help: A Herbalism roll in the first round adds its bonus to the Medicine roll.
medical-no-targets: The patient has no injury to treat and is not dying
medical-result-absolute-failure-explanat: The treatment goes wrong and harms the patient: the wound gets worse, and so does its penalty.
medical-result-absolute-success-explanat: An outstanding treatment: the procedure works fully and the recovery is faster.
medical-result-failure-explanation: The treatment does not help. The injury stays as it was and recovers as untreated.
medical-result-partial-success-explanati: The treatment partly works: the procedure has a reduced effect, and the recovery roll takes the modifier the table gives.
medical-result-success-explanation: The procedure works: it stops or slows the bleeding, or closes the wound, as the procedure says. The injury then recovers as treated.
medical-roll-help: The Medicine roll is made in the first round; the treatment applies when the last round is reached.
medical-rounds-from-core: The rounds are the core duration of the procedure.
medical-rounds-override: The rounds typed replace the core duration.
medical-stabilize-help: One Medicine roll for each round of 4 AP.
medical-waiting-complete: The treatment applies when the action has {{ap}} AP
medical-waiting-step: Resolvable when the action has {{ap}} AP
melee-cover-declared-help: A cover is already declared: the combatants in the way give no extra cover, but a miss may still hit one of them.
melee-cover-help: Combatants engaged with the target give it cover ({{value}}). If the shot misses, one of them may take it.
melee-cover-no-candidates: No other combatants in the game.
member-rolls: Rolls and bonuses of each actor (optional)
member-rolls-missing-bonus_one: {{count}} actor without a fear RR bonus is left out
member-rolls-missing-bonus_other: {{count}} actors without a fear RR bonus are left out
modifier-section-defender-help: How the target defends: they change its DB, shield or parry, not the roll.
modifier-section-roll-help: They add to or subtract from the attack roll.
modifier-section-special-help: They change other rules of the attack and have no fixed value.
morale-average-excluded_one: Left out of the average (no bonus to the fear RR): {{names}}
morale-average-excluded_other: {{count}} left out of the average (no bonus to the fear RR): {{names}}
morale-modifier-warning-until-lifted: Later morale rolls {{value}} until the game master removes it.
morale-outcome-needs-clarification: They hesitate and need it explained
movement-dash-help: Takes the instantaneous action too; it covers more ground per AP.
movement-distance-roll-note: With a roll, each distance is multiplied by the % of the maneuver result.
movement-left-help: What the actor can still move this round, up to its maximum pace
movement-limit-double-concentration: Concentrating on two things: creeping only
movement-limit-fear: Fear limits where it can go
movement-limit-grapple: Grappling: a Feat of Strength is needed to move away
movement-next-check: Fatigue towards the next Endurance check
movement-nothing-left: The actor has already moved all it can this round.
movement-pace-help: Choose the pace: a slower one caps what the round covers; a faster one than the AP covers the same and adds fatigue.
movement-pace-of-ap: Pace of the AP spent this round
movement-pace-over-ap: Same distance with these AP; only adds fatigue
movement-pace-reached: The round has already covered this pace
movement-prone-note: Prone: half the BMR and up to jog.
movement-slow-max-jog: Backwards or prone it goes up to jog
no-aim-weapons: No ranged weapon covered by Sharpshooter
no-ap-in-phase: No action points in this phase
no-characters-available-for-faction: No characters available for this faction
no-instant-spells: The character knows no instantaneous spells.
npc-no-spells: NPCs do not cast spells yet
other-action-help: Some actions take a fixed number of AP. Those of more than 4 AP last several rounds.
other-action-intro: Pick a kind with a fixed cost, or a free-form action of 1 to 4 AP.
other-action-multi-round: It takes more than one round: it goes on in the next rounds until its AP are spent.
outcome-applied-at: Applied to the strategic model on {{date}}.
outcome-applied-to-strategic: Outcome applied to the strategic model
outcome-apply-failed-n_one: {{count}} character could not be applied: retry
outcome-apply-failed-n_other: {{count}} characters could not be applied: retry
outcome-not-applied-help: The outcome has not reached the strategic characters yet: apply it to update their hits, injuries and conditions.
outside-action-phases: Only during the action phases of the current round
palette-fear-fear-balk: Balking: no charges and limited pace this round
palette-fear-fear-broken: Broken: only flee (run or faster), dodge and free actions; it may drop what it holds
palette-fear-fear-retreat: Retreating: moves away from the enemy, no charges
palette-fear-fear-routed: Routed: only flee (run or faster), dodge and free actions
palette-fear-only-flee-fear-broken: Broken: it can only flee, dodge or take free actions
palette-fear-only-flee-fear-routed: Routed: it can only flee, dodge or take free actions
parry-consequence: If you give {{parry}}, for the rest of the round you keep OB: {{attacks}}.
parry-exclusion-no-action: It has no melee attack declared this round: only who fights in melee can parry or protect.
parry-exclusion-parry-forbidden: {{effect}}: this effect keeps it from parrying.
parry-exclusion-parry-last-action: Its last action with AP is not a melee attack ({{actionType}}): only who fights in melee can parry or protect.
parry-exclusion-parry-no-ob: It has no OB left to give: OB {{bo}}, penalties {{penalty}}.
parry-maneuver-failed: {{result}}, below a success: the parry is 0
parry-maneuver-help: Parrying a further foe in the same round needs an absolute Combat Training maneuver (already parried this round: {{foes}}). Only a success or better lets the parry count; below it the parry is 0 and takes no OB.
parry-maneuver-required: Further foe ({{foes}} already parried): Combat Training maneuver {{skill}}
parry-nobody-because: Nobody can parry this attack. The reasons are below.
parry-positional-reduction: The position takes {{reduction}} off this parry: it adds {{left}} to the DB
passive-total-help: Conflicting maneuver: total of the passive side. Adds 100 minus this total.
physical-rr-bonus-required: This actor has no RR in its sheet: type its physical RR bonus.
physical-rr-bonus-sheet: Leave the bonus empty to use the one of the sheet: {{value}}.
poison-exposure-help: The poison waits for its resistance roll among the pending poisons of the actor.
poison-exposures-none: No poisons waiting for an RR
precision-ob-penalty-help: Taken from the attack, makes the maneuver as much easier
protect-up-to: Can protect with up to {{max}} of {{attack}}
reaction-attack-help: Reaction attack ({{trait}}): 0 AP and no parry reduction.
reaction-attack-help-ob: Reaction attack ({{trait}}): fixed OB {{ob}}, 0 AP and no parry reduction.
reaction-no-weapon: The actor has no melee weapon of the talent's specialization.
reason-bolt-split: Split the OB of the bolt among its targets.
reason-ob-zero: Give some OB to each attack with a target: an attack at 0 is not made.
reason-parry-maneuver: Enter the parry maneuver roll, or mark it passed or failed.
reason-pick-range: Enter the range to each target.
reason-pick-target: Choose a target for at least one attack.
reason-special-maneuver: Enter the defender's roll of the special maneuver.
resolution-blocked-reason: {{ap}} AP of a minimum of {{min}}: it can be prepared, but not resolved yet.
resolution-unreachable-reason: {{ap}} AP of a minimum of {{min}}: it will not reach the minimum this round.
roll-all-initiatives-confirmation: Some actors already have an initiative. Roll again for every actor?
roll-preview-note: Values are a guide: the final breakdown, with the attacker's penalties, comes after Prepare.
roster-locked-in-progress: The game has started: characters can be added but not removed
roster-npcs-locked-in-progress: The game has started: NPCs can no longer be added or removed
sense-selection-warm-target: Warm or cold target close by
sense-target-actor-help: Its odour talents change the roll
shield-maneuver-help: From the second attack the shield covers, each attack needs a Shield maneuver: with success or better the shield adds its DB; otherwise it adds nothing, and the block is spent anyway.
shortcut-actor-detail: Open the full sheet of the selected actor
shortcut-declare: Declare an action for the selected actor
shortcut-next-phase: Start the next phase or round
shortcut-open-action: Open the selected actor's pending action
shortcut-select-actor: Select the next or previous actor
shortcut-select-actor-arrows: Same, once an actor is selected
similar-skill-help: Roll this skill in place of the one the maneuver needs: a penalty for how they relate and how similar they are, and only the bonus counts, never the ranks.
similar-skill-relation-help: Read from the skill categories unless the game master rules otherwise.
simple-action-help-aim: Takes the whole round (4 AP). Declaring any other action, or taking damage, loses the aim.
simple-action-help-dodge: A full dodge or full block takes the whole round (4 AP): choose which one. It sets the actor's defence for the round.
simple-action-help-draw_and_load: Spends the phases it takes. Note what is drawn or loaded.
simple-action-help-other: Describe the action in the note: it is kept in the round log.
simple-action-help-stand_up: Completing it clears the actor's prone state.
spell-attack-next-ball: The ball now attacks every target in its area: {{table}} with OB {{bo}} (fumble up to {{fumble}}), one attack per target, without dodge. Choose the targets, then roll each attack.
spell-attack-next-bolt: The bolt now attacks like a ranged weapon: {{table}} with OB {{bo}} (fumble up to {{fumble}}). Choose its target and range, then roll the attack.
spell-bolt-ob-split-help: With Scope Skills the bolt strikes {{count}} targets and splits its OB {{bo}} among them: in equal parts, or as you give each one.
spell-bolt-ob-split-over: The parts add up to {{total}}, above the OB of the bolt ({{bo}})
spell-cast-failure-roll: SCR {{scr}}: the spell fails. Roll on the spell failure table to see what happens to the caster.
spell-cast-no-effect: SCR 0: the spell has no effect and the power points are lost.
spell-cast-rule-armor: The armor ({{armor}}) hinders some realms more than others; this is the value of the {{column}} column.
spell-cast-rule-custom: A bonus or penalty the game master adds for the situation.
spell-cast-rule-eloquence: Eloquence: +5 per tier ({{tier}}) to every Spellcasting Roll.
spell-cast-rule-fast-casting: Casting with fewer action points than the spell usually takes is penalized for each one missing.
spell-cast-rule-grace: Grace offsets the overcasting penalty, never more than it.
spell-cast-rule-hands: Free hands to gesture ({{hands}}), read in the column of the realm ({{column}}).
spell-cast-rule-helmet: The helmet ({{helmet}}) hinders some realms more than others; this is the value of the {{column}} column.
spell-cast-rule-list-type: Own base lists are easier to cast than open, closed or other professions' lists.
spell-cast-rule-mumbler: Mumbler: -5 per tier ({{tier}}) to every Spellcasting Roll.
spell-cast-rule-overcasting: The spell is {{levels}} levels above the caster (level {{spellLevel}} against {{casterLevel}}): each level above is penalized.
spell-cast-rule-pace: The caster moves freely at {{pace}} while casting, without spending action points: the faster the pace, the larger the penalty.
spell-cast-rule-penalty-critical: Penalties of the criticals taken in this game.
spell-cast-rule-penalty-endurance: Penalty of failed endurance rolls in this game.
spell-cast-rule-penalty-fatigue: Accumulated fatigue from failed endurance rolls.
spell-cast-rule-penalty-fortitude: Fortitude takes off part of the other penalties.
spell-cast-rule-penalty-hp: Lost hit points weaken the caster.
spell-cast-rule-penalty-injury: Penalties of the injuries the caster carries.
spell-cast-rule-penalty-non-violent: The caster is in a non-violent state and acts with a penalty.
spell-cast-rule-penalty-stunned: A stunned caster casts with a penalty.
spell-cast-rule-perfected-technique: Perfected Technique: +5 per tier ({{tier}}) to the spells of the list it was taken for ({{list}}).
spell-cast-rule-preparation: Each round spent preparing the spell helps, up to a maximum.
spell-cast-rule-ranks: Ranks in the spell list: the base of the casting roll.
spell-cast-rule-realm-stat: Bonus of the stat of the caster's realm ({{realm}}).
spell-cast-rule-spell-trickery: Spell Trickery offsets the subtlety, hands and voice penalties, never more than them.
spell-cast-rule-subtlety: Casting without being noticed is harder; how much depends on the spell type ({{type}}) and the realm column ({{column}}).
spell-cast-rule-talents: A magical talent of the caster.
spell-cast-rule-transcendence: Transcendence offsets the helmet and armor penalties, never more than them.
spell-cast-rule-voice: How loud the caster speaks ({{voice}}), read in the column of the realm ({{column}}).
spell-cast-skip-armor-no-penalty: The armor ({{armor}}) does not hinder casting in the {{column}} column.
spell-cast-skip-helmet-no-penalty: The helmet ({{helmet}}) does not hinder casting in the {{column}} column.
spell-cast-skip-subtlety-not-requested: The cast is not subtle: it takes no subtlety penalty, but anyone around notices it.
spell-cast-success-rr: The spell is cast (SCR {{scr}}). It is not over yet: each target rolls a resistance roll (RR) and resists if it reaches {{scr}}.
spell-effects-manual: Not applied automatically yet: the game master applies them to the affected targets.
spell-failure-talent-modifier: Talents of the caster (Inglorious Failure, Graceful Recovery): {{value}}; the total is never below 1.
spell-outcome-all-resist: Every target resisted: the spell affects no one.
spell-outcome-failure: The spell failed: apply the spell failure result to the caster.
spell-outcome-no-rr: No resistance roll was made: decide by hand which targets are affected.
spell-outcome-no-rr-needed: The spell takes no resistance roll: its effects apply as cast.
spell-power-recycling-proposal_one: Power Recycling: {{count}} PP instead of {{base}} ({{recycled}} recycled)
spell-power-recycling-proposal_other: Power Recycling: {{count}} PP instead of {{base}} ({{recycled}} recycled)
spell-result-failure-explanation: A casting roll below 0 ({{scr}}) fails. The caster rolls on the spell failure table of its realm, adding the penalties that made the cast fail; the result says what happens and how many power points are lost.
spell-result-no-effect: No effect: the power points are lost
spell-result-no-effect-explanation: A casting roll of exactly 0 does nothing: the spell fizzles and its power points are lost.
spell-result-success-explanation: A casting roll above 0 casts the spell. Its targets may still resist it: the casting roll ({{scr}}) is what their resistance rolls must reach.
spell-rr-help: Resistance roll of each target: open-ended d100 + its RR bonus against {{realm}}, {{levelModifier}} for the caster level ({{level}}){{spellPart}}. It resists if the total reaches the SCR, {{scr}}; otherwise it is affected.
spell-rr-rule-armor: Against this realm ({{realm}}), the target's armor ({{armor}}) helps it resist.
spell-rr-rule-caster-level: Twice the caster's level ({{level}}): stronger casters are harder to resist.
spell-rr-rule-cover: Cover between caster and target ({{cover}}) helps to resist.
spell-rr-rule-helmet: Against Mentalism, a helmet ({{helmet}}) protects the mind of the target.
spell-rr-rule-iron-will: Iron Will: +5 per tier ({{tier}}) to resist mental attacks.
spell-rr-rule-range: The closer the target ({{range}}), the harder it is to resist.
spell-rr-rule-resistance: The target's resistance bonus against the realm of the spell ({{realm}}).
spell-rr-rule-spell: Some spells are easier or harder to resist by themselves.
spell-rr-rule-surprised-stunned: A surprised or stunned target resists worse.
spell-rr-rule-willing: A target that accepts the spell barely resists it.
spell-rr-skip-rr-armor-not-mentalism: Armor does not protect against Mentalism: only a helmet does.
spell-rr-skip-rr-helmet-only-mentalism: A helmet only helps against Mentalism; this spell is {{realm}}.
spell-rr-skip-rr-organic-only-essence: Organic armor only helps against Essence; this spell is {{realm}}.
spell-target-affected: {{name}} does not resist (RR {{total}} against {{required}}, short by {{failure}}): affected.
spell-target-willing: {{name}} is willing: affected without a roll.
stabilize-no-rounds-gained: The dying actor gains no rounds.
stray-shot-attack-help: Stray shot: the attack goes at OB 0, without cover, against {{target}}, and fumbles are ignored.
stray-shot-expired: The round has ended: the stray shot is no longer available.
stun-immune-help: Any stun is a flat -25 for 1 round and does not stack.
style-critical-effect-binding-chain: Binding Chain: Grapple critical instead of {{type}}.
style-critical-effect-lancers-knockback: Lancer's Knockback: severity lowered from {{severity}}. The foe is knocked back {{feet}}' and needs a medium Running or Acrobatics maneuver to stay standing.
style-critical-effect-leg-sweep: Leg Sweep: severity lowered from {{severity}}. The foe must beat the attack roll ({{roll}}) with a Running maneuver or fall prone.
style-critical-effect-redirect: Redirect: severity lowered from {{severity}}. Move the foe up to {{feet}}' in a direction of your choice, no more than they moved last round.
style-critical-effect-slowing-shot: Slowing Shot: severity lowered from {{severity}}. The foe's BMR drops {{feet}}' (to half at most).
style-critical-effect-weapon-breaker: Weapon Breaker: severity lowered from {{severity}}. The foe's weapon makes a breakage check at -25.
style-critical-option-help: Abilities of the active style that change the critical. Some must be decided now; the rest can wait for the critical roll.
style-equipment-not-met: Without the equipment of the style: no bonus
subdual-adjustment: Subdual: {{base}} hits of the table → {{damage}}; critical of the table: {{critical}}.
subdual-bonus-help: Entered by the game master: it offsets the penalties of the table and of an unfamiliar anatomy, never beyond them.
surprise-declaration-help: Surprised: loses the first 2 AP, or 1 after a successful Perception. Flatfooted: no initiative and no actions this round.
tactical-game-finished-read-only: The game is finished: it is read-only.
temperature-not-extreme: Not an extreme temperature of this kind
trading-price-help: Result {{percent}}%: the deal closes at {{value}}% of the asked price.
unusual-leader-fired-up: Unusual event: the leader is fired up ({{bonus}} to its fear RR, {{hits}} hits).
unusual-misunderstands-order: Unusual event: the order is misunderstood.
use-item-help: Takes 2 AP. The dose is spent when the outcome of the game is applied.
use-item-roll-help: Left empty, the API rolls the hits of the item.
